acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Serpents family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Crown Serpent, T5, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Living-Coil Sovereign archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two water construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: Colossal plausible snake with crown-like occipital scales, long patterned body, four recognizable scar bands, and no humanoid torso.
Signature mechanic: Crown Coil: one crown scale lifts for each tightening body ring; the lower Serpent guarding that gap defines how it closes.
battlefieldDuty: Encircle the arena in layered body coils and assign lower Serpents to the gaps between them.
constructionDimensions: Glossy wet scales, translucent pressure membranes, coherent venom-water channels, and streaming body edges preserve segmentation.
Ripples trace body tension and attack lanes while drainage reveals the anchor or extended neck.
counterplay: Remove or displace the still guard, cross the loosened coil, and strike the lifted crown scale before tightening resumes. Affinity signal: The loaded throat sac, anchor scute, or crown channel drains after release and exposes the same physical weak point.
forbiddenTreatments: Opaque water that conceals coil boundaries or fangs
identityInvariants: Every form remains limbless with a continuous scaled body, snake skull, jaw hinge, belly scutes, forked tongue, and species-appropriate tail.
Tier escalation uses body proportion, hood, fangs, horns, crown scales, muscle distribution, and coil behavior rather than arms or equipment.
Strike range, head anchor, venom direction, emergence point, and loosened coil remain visually traceable.
telegraph: Crown scales lift in the order of the next constriction and the corresponding lower Serpent becomes still.
